title: Constructor claims a first as it launches Agentic Checkout solution powered by Stripe payments
key_facts: Constructor, which powers search and product discovery for retailers including Sephora, The Very Group, Monica Vinader, White Stuff and Furniture Village, launched Agentic Checkout.
The company claims it is the first to offer Stripe-powered checkout directly inside an onsite shopping agent.
Shoppers can discover products, ask questions, get recommendations, and pay without leaving the agent.
Payment options include the Link by Stripe digital wallet or other methods.
It runs inside Constructor’s AI Shopping Agent and AI Product Insights Agent.
It is due to expand to more touchpoints on retailers’ sites later this year.
quote_evidence: People on retail sites and apps can discover products, ask questions, get personalised recommendations, and refine their choices, then check out and pay, without leaving the agent experience.
Agentic Checkout will expand to more touchpoints throughout retailers’ digital properties later this year.
why_it_matters_hint: AI shopping assistants on retailer sites can now complete the purchase, not just recommend.
notes: Single trade outlet relaying the company’s announcement; the "first" claim is Constructor’s.
